name: photocraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for PhotoCraft: edit photos (resize, crop, adjustments, Camera Raw, 123 filters, remove background, text, shapes, layer styles), create designs and convert between PSD, TIFF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, EXR and more with PhotoCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . photocraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Edit photos and create images with your local PhotoCraft
defaultPrompt: Remove the background of this photo and make it white
Resize every image in this folder to 1080 px and export WebP
Create a 1080x1080 social post with my logo and a title
